# Rovaq AI

> Rovaq AI connects conversations, orders and refunds to show where revenue is at risk. Every figure comes with its source and its cut-off date. Always gross revenue, never margin. Exposure is an inferred figure, not a loss.

Content updated: 2026-10-28.

---

## Know how much money slips away, and why.

Post-purchase revenue intelligence for businesses that sell on marketplaces

Rovaq AI measures observed refunds and the revenue exposed to each problem, with the evidence in plain view and every figure labeled Observed, Estimated or Inferred.

Always gross revenue, never margin. Exposure is an inferred figure, not a loss.

### Every problem, with its exposed revenue and its evidence.

A repeated theme is not the same as a theme that costs. Rovaq puts beside each problem its exposed revenue, where it comes from, the date it reaches and what is still unknown.

- Gross revenue, never margin.
- What is unknown says No data, never zero.
- Currencies kept apart, never converted.
- A person decides every action.

### The information that explains your revenue leaks is scattered.

And nobody connects it.

- Three places, no single view. Conversations sit in a support tool, orders and refunds in each marketplace, and reports in spreadsheets.
- A silent leak. Refunds that could be claimed and are not make a silent leak. Without seeing them by channel and by product, there is nowhere to act.
- A deadline that passes. Missed response times show up after the customer has already complained. Knowing when threads arrive makes it possible to staff in time.
- Figures that read as facts. Spreadsheet reports often mix currencies, treat missing data as zero and present estimates as facts.

### Every figure says where it comes from.

### Four classes of figure and a single rule.

- Observed. Recorded at the source, such as orders and settled refunds.
- Estimated. Calculated with a model or with assumptions you define. It is not a recorded fact.
- Inferred. Linked by evidence, such as the revenue of orders tied to a problem. It is not a loss and is not added across problems.
- No data. There are no eligible records. It is never shown as zero.

The rule. Under every important figure goes its seal: class, source, cut-off date and age. If the cut-off date is unknown, the seal says so.

### Four modules, and a person who decides.

Each module does one part of the work with your data. They are not autonomous agents: they propose and prepare, and a person approves every action.

- Import with provenance. Bring in HubSpot conversations and orders or refunds from Excel and CSV. Every record keeps its source and cut-off date. Marketplaces come in by export, with help from our team.
- Group into problems. Each problem shows its volume and evidence when links are confirmed. Emails and phone numbers are masked. See what repeats. Grouping with AI models is enabled per organization.
- Quantify in gross revenue. Each problem shows exposed gross revenue, labeled Inferred and never as a loss. Every figure carries class, source and cut-off. Exposure is calculated only with the problem-to-order links that an owner confirmed.
- Decide and measure. Each recommendation brings its evidence. A person decides: Proceed, Adjust or Dismiss. Nothing is sent automatically; the outcome is recorded. Proceed creates the intervention and drafts that a person reviews and sends.

### Six screens, each built to answer one question.

Walk through the product with example data. No data is from a customer.

- [Today](https://rovaq.ai/en/product/today). What needs attention today. Four key figures based on the sources you have loaded: gross revenue, refunds, stuck money and replies over 24 hours, each with period, formula and coverage.
- Refund leakage. Where returned money concentrates. See where returned money concentrates by channel and product, and download an evidence package. You review it and you file it.
- Problems with evidence. Which problem to prioritize and with which cases. Each problem is presented with its volume and its evidence when links are confirmed. Economic exposure is an Inferred figure: revenue from orders linked to the problem, not a loss.
- [Ask your data](https://rovaq.ai/en/product/ask-your-data). How this figure was reached. Type a question and get figures, tables and charts. It runs on rules, without a language model, shows how it calculated and says when it does not have the data.
- [To decide](https://rovaq.ai/en/product/to-decide). What is proposed and who decides. Every proposal arrives with its evidence and its reason. A person decides: Proceed, Adjust or Dismiss, and the outcome is recorded.
- [Data trust](https://rovaq.ai/en/product/data-trust). How much to trust a figure. A traffic light per source, the freshness of each figure, its coverage and a list of what is still unknown. It is trust in the data, not a certification.

### Each role sees what belongs to it.

- Owner. Configures, decides and approves. Manages team, notices and retention. All screens, the team, notices and retention.
- Analyst. Investigates, prepares and proposes. Sees money and imports files. Money, problems, pain points and imports. Proposes and does not approve.
- Operator. Carries out the actions assigned to them. Sees problems and actions, without money figures. Problems, assigned actions and evidence. No money figures.
- Viewer. Reads with read-only access, with no risk of changing anything. The screens that apply to them, unable to modify data, connections or decisions.

Finance and customer experience read the same problem: the money that is returned and the reason it is returned.

Authorization is decided on the server. Hiding a menu item does not protect a screen.

### Security described by what exists today and what does not yet.

What exists.

- Each organization is kept apart from the others by rules in the database, not only by the application.
- Four roles with least-privilege permissions. The platform administration permission is separate and does not grant read access to the business data of other organizations.
- Sign-in is by a link sent to your email, with email confirmation, and sessions use protected cookies.
- Connections to your sources request read permissions.
- Pain-point and claim exports are generated without personal data.
- Administration operations, team changes and retention deletions are recorded.
- When AI is involved, it classifies and drafts. It does not produce amounts, and a person decides.

What does not exist yet.

- We do not hold SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification, and we do not claim GDPR compliance.
- No external penetration test has been performed.
- Two-step verification for owners is on our roadmap. It is not required today.
- We do not offer single sign-on or a customer-facing audit view.
- There are daily provider backups, without point-in-time recovery, and we make no availability commitments.

### What Rovaq does not do.

The limits are part of the product too.

- It does not calculate margin or profit. Everything is gross revenue.
- It does not convert currencies or add them. USD, CAD and MXN are kept apart.
- It does not present exposure as a loss. It is an inferred figure and is not added across problems.
- It is not an autonomous agent. It prepares the package and the draft; a person files the claim and decides every action.
- It does not promise recovery, savings or return. What is recoverable is an estimate based on assumptions you enter.
- It does not work in real time. Sync is scheduled and every screen shows its cut-off date.
- It does not connect directly with Amazon, Walmart or Shopify. Today their exports are loaded.
- It does not use a language model to answer in Ask your data and it does not search the internet.
- It holds no SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification, does not claim GDPR compliance, and two-step verification for owners is on the roadmap.
- It does not replace your support tool. It reads HubSpot conversations in read-only mode and does not write to your CRM.

If anything on this list changes, it will be stated here.

### What connects today and what comes next.

HubSpot, read-only, and Excel and CSV files. Marketplaces come in today through their exports.

Available today.

- HubSpot. Reading of conversations, read-only, with a scheduled sync every 5 minutes. It is not real time and coverage is limited to what the HubSpot API exposes: every screen shows its cut-off date. The connection is set up with our team.
- Excel and CSV. File upload with preview and validation before ingesting. Marketplace exports are loaded with help from our team.

On the roadmap.

- Direct connectors for Amazon, Walmart and Shopify. Today their exports are loaded.
- A full problem map by shipping address, which requires those connectors.
- Two-step verification for owners.

Rovaq does not replace your support tool. It reads HubSpot conversations in read-only mode and connects them with the orders and refunds you load.

### Frequently asked questions

#### What is Rovaq AI?

It is revenue intelligence for businesses that sell on marketplaces and support customers across channels. It connects conversations, orders and refunds, and shows every figure with its class, source and cut-off date.

#### Which sources does it work with today?

With HubSpot, read-only, and with Excel and CSV files. Amazon, Walmart and Shopify are on the roadmap: today their exports are loaded with help from our team.

#### Is the data updated in real time?

No. HubSpot syncs on a schedule every 5 minutes and file uploads are manual. Every figure shows the date its data reaches and how long ago it was updated.

#### Does Rovaq calculate my margin or how much money I lose?

It does not calculate margin: everything is gross revenue. Refunds are observed figures. Exposure per problem is an inferred figure: the revenue of orders linked to that problem, which is not the same as a loss.

#### Does Rovaq use AI and where?

Ask your data answers with rules and read-only tools, without a language model, and shows its steps. Grouping and classifying conversations can use AI models when the organization enables it. AI does not create amounts and a person decides every action.

#### Does Rovaq claim refunds for me?

No. It assembles a package of aggregated evidence and a draft message. You review them and file the claim. Nothing is sent on its own and no recovered amount is promised.

#### How secure is it and what certifications do you hold?

There is isolation per organization in the database, four roles, read connections and a record of administration operations. We hold no SOC 2 or ISO 27001, we have not run an external penetration test and two-step verification for owners is on the roadmap. The detail is on the Security page.

#### Does Rovaq replace my support tool?

No. It reads HubSpot conversations in read-only mode and connects them with the orders and refunds you load. It does not write to your CRM or reply to your customers.

#### How do I request access and what does it cost?

Request access at https://rovaq.ai/en/request-access with your role and the tools you use. We review your case and tell you what can be loaded or connected today. Pricing is not published yet.

## Today: four figures with period, formula and coverage

What needs attention today, with every figure labeled by its class and its source.

### What the screen shows

- Four key figures: gross revenue, refunds, stuck money and replies over 24 hours, each with its period.
- A Needs your attention block with alerts, such as a leak on one product, overdue requests or threads without a reply.
- The Suggested next action and a button to export the report.

### How to read a partial figure

Stuck money comes from an Excel Tracker that is loaded by hand and carries no cut-off date. Replies over 24 hours come from HubSpot. Every figure states its coverage and what is still unknown.

### What it does not calculate

- It does not calculate margin or profit: revenue is gross.
- It does not add or convert different currencies, because there is no approved exchange rate.
- An empty state says there is no data yet and never shows it as zero.

### Who sees it

All four roles, with different views. Owner and analyst see the four figures. Operator and viewer see a view of their own, without money figures.

_Example data. Not from a customer._

Fuente: https://rovaq.ai/en/product/pain-points

## Pain points: which reason repeats and what it carries

Tell what repeats from what costs.

### Bubble map

- Each bubble is a pain point. Its size is returned money in gross dollars or volume, your choice.
- The eight largest appear in the chart and in an accessible table, with a topic filter.
- Each row opens its evidence down to the source row.

### Export without personal data

Export the evidence as CSV per pain point, without personal data. What is not known says No data and never zero.

### What it does not do

- A repeated theme is not a theme that costs: the screen puts the money it carries beside it, when it exists.
- If a source did not respond, those points show as Not available now and not as zero.

_Example data. Not from a customer._

Fuente: https://rovaq.ai/en/product/ask-your-data

## Ask your data: calculated figures, visible steps

How this figure was reached, in plain view.

### How an answer is calculated

You type a question and get figures, tables and charts, each with its class and coverage. Figures come from read-only tools and are calculated with rules, without a language model.

### Steps in view

- Each answer can be opened in How I got here, with the steps, the parameters, the method and the source.
- The steps were recorded by the system; they are not the internal reasoning of a model.
- You can copy, download as CSV, rate the answer and attach a file of up to 1 MB that is analyzed only in your browser.

### What it does not do

- This describes the general agent of this screen. The Finance mode has its own engine and we do not claim it is rules only.
- It does not use a language model to answer and does not search the internet.
- When it does not have the data, it says so and does not invent it. If the question does not match an available query, it asks you to clarify.
- The monthly budget limits queries; when it runs out, direct queries remain.

### Who sees it

All four roles. The operator receives totals and not specific customers.

_Example data. Not from a customer._

Fuente: https://rovaq.ai/en/product/to-decide

## To decide: proposal, a person decides, outcome recorded

What is proposed and who decides.

### The life of a proposal

Each recommendation brings its evidence, why it is suggested and what is expected. A person decides, and the outcome is recorded with its before and after measurement, using observed data only.

### Proceed, Adjust or Dismiss

- Proceed creates the intervention and the drafts that a person reviews and sends. Nothing is sent automatically.
- Adjust and Dismiss ask for a reason, which is recorded. Reopening a dismissed proposal creates a new event and deletes nothing.
- Propose: owner, analyst and operator. Approve: owner only. Carry out: owner and operator.

### Outcome record

In progress shows the owner, the commitment, the stages and the drafts. Outcomes measures before and after and never presents an assumed saving.

_Example data. Not from a customer._

---

Fuente: https://rovaq.ai/en/product/data-trust

## Data trust: freshness, coverage and what is unknown

How much to trust a figure.

### Freshness and coverage

- A traffic light per source: Up to date, Manual load, Delayed, Alert, Paused or No data.
- The freshness of each figure: when it was recalculated and the date its data reaches.
- Coverage, with windows per channel.
- A How it was calculated panel on each figure, with its origin, period and formula.

### What is still unknown

What we do not know is a task list: the affected figure, what closes it and its basis. A source that never ran appears as No data and not as Up to date. Manual loads do not raise an alert.

### Data trust is not certification

This screen is about the quality of the figures. It is not a security or compliance certification.

_Example data. Not from a customer._

---

Fuente: https://rovaq.ai/en/product/finance

## Finance: a report by currency, bases never mixed

What the report says by currency.

### Gross revenue by currency

- Revenue, orders, refunds and refund rate by currency, with a 12-month series and the mix by channel.
- The monthly comparison only between complete months; incomplete months are dotted.
- A three-month projection with a range, labeled Estimated, which is not shown with fewer than four complete months.

### Cutoffs and reconciliation

Every figure states its currency, basis and period. What is missing appears as a task list and not as a zero. A figure with incomplete reconciliation is flagged as partial. The report is exported as CSV and PDF with the same figures as the screen.

### What it does not calculate

- It does not calculate margin or profit: everything is gross revenue.
- It does not add or convert USD, CAD and MXN, and does not subtract refunds from revenue because they are different bases.
- Exposure per problem shows as Not available until each problem is linked to its orders.

### Who sees it

Owner and analyst. Operator and viewer get a notice that their role has no access to this panel.

_Example data. Not from a customer._

Fuente: https://rovaq.ai/en/use-cases/owner

## Owner: configure, decide and approve

Manages team, notices and retention, and approves actions. Approving belongs to this role alone.

### What they configure

- Invites the team by email with a role; invitations expire and give no access until accepted.
- Connects sources with help from our team and authorizes imports.
- Sets the organization notice delivery and the retention and deletion policy, which first shows the exact scope and deletes nothing until confirmed.

### What they decide

- Approves, adjusts or dismisses the proposals in To decide.
- Confirms the problem-to-order links that exposure depends on.
- Publishes the organization order and refund cutoffs.

### What is recorded

Administration operations, team changes and retention deletions are recorded. The platform administration permission is separate and does not grant read access to the business data of other organizations.

_Example data. Not from a customer._

---

Fuente: https://rovaq.ai/en/use-cases/analyst

## Analyst: investigate, prepare and propose

Sees money and imports files. Proposes and does not approve.

### What they investigate

- Refund leakage, Problems, Pain points, Finance and the money figures in Today.
- Any figure, down to its source, with the How it was calculated panel.

### What they prepare

- Imports Excel and CSV files with preview and validation.
- Builds the evidence package and exports reports with the same figures as the screen.

### Where the role ends

The analyst proposes recommendations but does not approve them or carry out interventions, and does not configure connections, retention or team. Those decisions belong to the owner.

_Example data. Not from a customer._

---

Fuente: https://rovaq.ai/en/use-cases/operator

## Operator: carries out the actions assigned to you

Sees problems and actions, without money figures.

### What they receive

- The interventions assigned to them, with their stages and the drafts ready to review.
- The recommendations to decide and the open problems, ordered by number of conversations.

### What they see and do not see

Sees problems, assigned actions and evidence. Does not see money figures and cannot import files. In Ask your data it receives totals and not specific customers.

### How they record the result

Moves the intervention stages, reviews and sends the drafts, and records the outcome. Proposing is also within the role; approving is not.

_Example data. Not from a customer._

---

Fuente: https://rovaq.ai/en/use-cases/viewer

## Viewer: read without any risk of changing anything

Reads with read-only access.

### What they can read

- The screens that apply to them: Today, Problems with their evidence, Data trust and the actions.
- Can export downloads of what they see.

### What they cannot do

Cannot modify data, connections or decisions, and does not see money figures. Authorization is decided on the server: hiding a menu item does not protect a screen.

### Who it is for

Leadership, finance and teams that need to read the figures with their evidence without touching anything.

_Example data. Not from a customer._
